title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode16 Mascot Wonderland

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All right! Time to put on another show, everyone☆

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Another show! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. You're all so full of energy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Shows are more important to him than anything, you know. Putting on one of our own will be a great way to help him discover his true feelings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All right, we'll start by assigning parts. Hm?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That stare tells me something's wrong. What is it?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Would you like to be part of the show as well?
You're welcome to join us if you'd like.

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course! Why don't you come join us on stage?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
And thank you!
It's always nice to have help from all the plushies.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ha! I've goooot it☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I just had the perfect idea!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hey, Miku! Where are you going?!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Where is Miku running off to?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I wonder what's gotten into her.

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is that you, Miku? Where did that costume come from?

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line: I found it backstage earlier!

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line: I figured if I'm going to do a show with all the plushies, I should look like one too! What do you think?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A mascot costume isn't quite the same thing as a plushie, but...

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: It's adorably terrifying!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Looks like everybody is ready.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone seems to like it. They're all smiling. Great idea, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line:
What about you, KAITO?
There was a costume of you back there, too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What? Really?
Um... I'll think about it. For now, I need to be able to move around.

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line: Okay! We can both wear them together next time☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, back to assigning parts. Let's get practicing!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Great work, everyone! It's almost time for opening night!

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line:
Hurray! I can't wait♪
Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What is it, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line: KAITO, it's Tsukasa! I think he's here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, I think you're right!

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line:
All right☆ Time to go say hello!
I'll just take this costume off and...

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line: Hrng.... Hnnggghhh!!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Miku, you're not stuck in there, are you?
Would you like some help?

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line:
Um... No, don't worry about it!
I'll just go say hi to him like this!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku, hold on!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: He's going to be awfully surprised if she suddenly shows up like that. Not much I can do about it now, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Looks like it's time to get ready for the show.

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Hey, are we going to see Tsukasa soon? I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, he should be here any moment.
Once he arrives, we can ask him to be in the show with us!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to seeing him too.
